sources.funding_note: Written by an adviser in the CCSS financial management division and published in the CCSS's own journal; submitted in 2019, published 2022. Treated as tier 3 (institutional) rather than independent peer review.

sources.title: The Health System in Costa Rica: Focus on the Management of Diabetes Mellitus

sources.title: Assessing performance of the Healthcare Access and Quality Index, overall and by select age groups, for 204 countries and territories, 1990-2019: a systematic analysis from the Global Burden of Disease Study 2019
sources.authors: GBD 2019 Healthcare Access and Quality Collaborators
